settings.title: Our Story
settings.content:
BrisaBetter began on a long drive, a simple conversation between mates about how trapped they felt by vaping. One of our founders didn’t vape himself, but he could see how hard it was for the people around him to quit. Nothing on the market felt honest, and nothing actually helped. So he set out to build something better for his friends first: A tool that helped them break the habit instead of feeding it.

We truly care about people’s health, and our lives revolve around it. We’re from Australia, and we see the problems firsthand within the culture, the stress, the addiction, the lack of real answers. That’s why BrisaBetter was built from a good place, and it will stay that way. No fake claims. No hidden chemicals. Just honest products made to help you feel better, live better, and move forward. And this is only the start, BrisaBetter will grow into a full range of health and wellness products designed with the same promise: real benefits, real transparency, and no shortcuts. A brand made to help you be better, for good.

settings.title: Our Founders
settings.content:
BrisaBetter was created by a small team of Australians who care deeply about health, honesty, and helping people break free from habits that hold them back. We choose to stay behind the scenes for now, not because we’re hiding, but because the focus should always be on the people we’re helping, not on us.

We’re builders, not influencers.

We’re here to create tools that genuinely improve people’s lives, and that will always be our priority.

settings.title: The BrisaBetter Promise
settings.content:
We build products the right way, honestly, carefully, and with a clear purpose. Every BrisaBetter product is designed by us, tested by us, and created to help people feel better without the lies, shortcuts, or hidden chemicals that big companies rely on.

Health in both body and mind is at the forefront of our thoughts at all times. We create products to genuinely better the people who use them, and we stay well away from the harmful, body-altering chemicals that show up in so many things on today’s market. If we can’t stand behind something with full confidence, we won’t release it. Simple.

BrisaBetter will always choose truth over hype, quality over convenience, and people over profit.

That’s our promise, now and in every product to come.
